name: met-in-unchanged-code
why: One criterion is the new endpoint the diff adds; the other, authentication on every endpoint, is met by unchanged lines of the same file, shown only in its full content. A quote from those lines proves it.
ticket_context:
### Jira ticket: [ORD-58](https://jira.example/browse/ORD-58)
**Title:** Orders list endpoint
**Type:** Story · **Status:** In Progress
**Acceptance criteria:** AC-1 GET /v2/orders returns the caller's orders. AC-2 Every endpoint requires an authenticated caller.

files.diff:
@@ -0,0 +1,14 @@
+package orders
+
+import (
+	"encoding/json"
+	"net/http"
+)
+
+func (s *Service) listOrders(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
+	orders, err := s.store.OrdersOf(r.Context(), callerFrom(r))
+	if err != nil {
+		http.Error(w, "internal error", http.StatusInternalServerError)
+		return
+	}
+	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(orders)
+}

expect.label: AC-2
expect.why: `return requireAuth(mux)` wraps every route; an unchanged line the diff shows as context.
